_meta.definition: Unifying activities related to managing aliases, names, and associated data for actors, movies, and companies.

aka_name._description: Captures alternate names and biographical information for individuals in the IMDb database.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for alternate names of movie entities.

columns.name: person_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the person_ entity

columns.name: name
columns.description: Stores variant names of actors and actresses.

columns.name: imdb_index
columns.description: Stores alternate names for individuals, often including nicknames or stage names.

columns.name: name_pcode_cf
columns.description: Stores IMDB alias names encoded as 10-character alphanumeric codes.

columns.name: name_pcode_nf
columns.description: Stores IMDB alias names with a 10-character numeric prefix code.

columns.name: surname_pcode
columns.description: Stores abbreviated surnames of actors/actresses in IMDB database.

columns.name: md5sum
columns.description: Stores MD5 hashes of alternate film names.

char_name._description: Captures character names and their associated metadata from IMDb, including unique identifiers, names, surnames, and checksums.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for characters in the IMDBJoinOrderBenchmark database.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Stores character names from various films and television shows.

columns.name: imdb_index
columns.description: Stores IMDb identifiers for characters, represented as text strings, often enclosed in quotes.

columns.name: imdb_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the imdb_ entity

columns.name: name_pcode_nf
columns.description: Stores unique 50-character alphanumeric codes for character names.

columns.name: surname_pcode
columns.description: Stores surname initials encoded as five-digit codes for characters in the IMDBJoinOrderBenchmark database.

columns.name: md5sum
columns.description: Stores MD5 hashes of character names.

company_name._description: Captures information about international film production companies and their unique identifiers.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for various IMDB companies.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Stores up to 255 characters of the names of various film production companies.

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for countries associated with film companies.

columns.name: imdb_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the imdb_ entity

columns.name: name_pcode_nf
columns.description: Stores 10-character alphanumeric codes for IMDB company names.

columns.name: name_pcode_sf
columns.description: Stores a 10-character alphanumeric code for IMDB company names.

columns.name: md5sum
columns.description: Stores unique MD5 hashes of company names.

name._description: Captures actor and actress names along with associated metadata for IMDB indexing and hashing.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for movie names in the database.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Stores up to 255 characters of filmmakers' names, including first names with initials and surnames.

columns.name: imdb_index
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for IMDb movies (II, XII, I, IV, V).

columns.name: imdb_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the imdb_ entity

columns.name: gender
columns.description: Stores character gender as either 'm' for male or 'f' for female (up to 10 characters).

columns.name: name_pcode_cf
columns.description: Stores 10-character alphanumeric production codes for movie names.

columns.name: name_pcode_nf
columns.description: Stores 10-character alphanumeric production codes for movie names.

columns.name: surname_pcode
columns.description: Stores abbreviated last names with a 10-character alphanumeric code.

columns.name: md5sum
columns.description: Stores unique MD5 hashes of movie names.
